title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
task: Recursive self-improvement through exploration in complex domains
key_results: Competitive or improved discovery quality with substantially reduced discovery cost across algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering
comments: The replay-simulator approach for off-policy feedback is clever, but gains rely on having accumulated discovery history—limiting applicability to early-stage exploration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Accumulated discovery history enables low-cost off-policy feedback for exploration refinement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—simulator-based dreaming reduces online evaluation cost while maintaining or improving solution quality

title: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
task: Agentic language model for scientific research and engineering
key_results: Competitive with frontier agents on 16 benchmarks, highest scores on 5; ~33% of AI-assisted tasks rated infeasible without AI by human participants
comments: Human-AI collaboration shows a shift from execution to project-level partnership, but evaluation relies on subjective participant ratings rather than objective discovery metrics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents trained on verified execution outcomes support effective human-AI collaboration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—agents propose methods and implementations while humans guide exploration and make final decisions

title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
task: Efficient 7B foundation model for math and agentic search
key_results: Competitive with 7B models on general benchmarks; on challenging math/agentic tasks, competitive with models 10-30x larger (Qwen3-235B, GLM-5.1); ~4.2x efficiency improvement in 16K pre-training
comments: The dual-phase curriculum (context scaling + MDP reformulation) is well-motivated, though gains may not transfer cleanly to domains without explicit agentic interactions.

model_io.model: ZGCM-1 (7B dense transformer, FP8 Muon optimizer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coupling deliberate internal thinking with external tool use overcomes parametric limits in compact models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—7B model competitive with 100B+ models on math/agentic tasks

title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
task: Real-time interactive and spatial video generation with editing
key_results: Real-time 720p generation with dynamic references and strong instruction following; real-time video editing (style, clothing, character, background); real-time spatial video generation feasibility demonstrated
comments: Claims of 'real-time' lack explicit latency/FPS numbers, making it difficult to assess practical deployment readiness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic reference conditioning improves controllability and realism in real-time video synthesis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—outperforms baselines on interactive generation tasks

title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
task: Unified physical foundation model for embodied understanding, action generation, and prediction
key_results: 8B model achieves 72.5 average across 28 embodied benchmarks (new SOTA); best open-source results on 14 benchmarks; on par with GPT-6-Astra and Gemini 3.6 Flash; generates end-effector trajectories and future scene predictions
comments: Evaluation is primarily on understanding benchmarks; actual closed-loop control performance on real robots is only shown qualitatively.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint training on observation, interaction, and prediction tasks creates unified embodied representations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—achieves SOTA on embodied understanding without task-specific fine-tuning

title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
task: Efficient KV caching via on-demand key reconstruction
key_results: 45-47% reduction in persistent cache scalars vs. matched GQA; 350M model achieves 44.18 avg accuracy (GQA 44.36, MLA-baseline 43.88); 16-dim positional variant near-GQA performance with compact representation
comments: Benchmark accuracy gains are modest; end-to-end inference speedup with custom kernels is promised but not yet demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reconstructing content keys via learned map reduces cache footprint without sacrificing accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed under FP32; results degrade under BF16 but remain competitive

title: LynnReal-Omni: Native multi-modal Video Generation for Agentic Visual Workflows
task: Native multimodal video generation with agentic control and structural conditioning
key_results: 32B multimodal diffusion transformer unifies 6+ generation modes; real-time Flash variant (27B) generates 22-frame 540p in 377ms on H100; MSAVP evaluation across 100 prompts with 20 metrics; enables agentic visual creation workflows
comments: The unified architecture is ambitious, but generalization across heterogeneous visual conditions (3D renders, game recordings, references) is not extensively validated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Accepting heterogeneous visual inputs enables stable, high-quality generation for agentic workflows
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—unified model supports multiple conditioning modalities without quality loss

title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
task: Training-free recursive self-improvement via autonomous memory construction in new environments
key_results: RSIAgent enables Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 to outperform frontier GPT-6; improvements on OSWorld-v2 and Agent's Last Exam; causal knowledge retention without parameter updates
comments: Training-free approach is valuable but evaluation is limited to two benchmarks; generalization to diverse environment types unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordinated broad-then-deep exploration discovers environment structure and hidden constraints without training
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—memory-based reuse improves downstream task performance without fine-tuning

title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
task: General-purpose open-ended discovery through coupled research capabilities
key_results: DFM framework with 7 coupled capabilities (problem discovery, formulation, representation, hypothesis, intervention, revision, improvement); GALILEO closed-loop system integrates dry-lab reasoning, robotic wet-lab, and biological evidence; code and framework released
comments: Framework is conceptually rich but GALILEO is presented as a case study without quantitative discovery metrics; unclear how to scale discovery to diverse domains.

model_io.model: Discovery Foundation Model (DFM) with Zetema instantiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coupled discovery capabilities enable progression from learning over existing knowledge to constructing new knowledge
hypotheses.result: Confirmed conceptually in GALILEO case study; quantitative validation limited

title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
task: Benchmarking agentic video understanding via programmatic reconstruction
key_results: 51 configurations evaluated; best model reaches 88.6 Latent Similarity but only 53.7% spatial-fact retention; additional reasoning improves visual similarity but not factual accuracy; Latent Similarity correlates strongly with human preference
comments: Programmatic reconstruction is a novel and rigorous test, but the gap between visual similarity and semantic retention suggests the benchmark may be too hard or the task formulation misaligned with understanding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Programmatic reconstruction is a valid proxy for agentic video understanding
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed—visual metrics align with human preference but semantic retention remains a major challenge

title: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video
task: Streaming camera-controllable video world model with panoramic-to-perspective decoding
key_results: Decouples panoramic world evolution from perspective rendering; chunk-autoregressive panoramic generation; 1,318-hour 4K+ panoramic dataset (MUGEN) with semantic/geometric annotations; supports long-horizon consistent generation
comments: Dataset and architectural contribution are significant, but no quantitative evaluation against baseline world models provided.

model_io.model: AlayaVista (panorama expansion + camera-conditioned panoramic latent state + latent viewport renderer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling panoramic evolution from perspective synthesis enables stable long-horizon generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed qualitatively; quantitative benchmarking against world models not provided

title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding? The Role of Numerical Precision in Orthrus
task: Evaluating losslessness of speculative decoding under numerical precision
key_results: Orthrus achieves exact trajectory matching in only 45% of cases under BF16 (not 100% as claimed); matching probability correlates with response-conditional perplexity; FP32 achieves 100% exact matching; downstream task performance unchanged despite trajectory divergence
comments: Important negative result: 'lossless' speculative decoding is precision-dependent, and practical losslessness claims should be qualified. Raises questions about other claimed lossless methods.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orthrus enables lossless speculative decoding via consensus mechanism
hypotheses.result: Refuted under BF16 (45% exact match); confirmed under FP32 but with precision caveat

title: Kaininja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
task: Part-level 3D generation extending single-mesh native generators
key_results: Dual-volume O-Voxel representation enables part-level generation; KaiNinja matches TRELLIS.2 speed/quality while supporting parts; 40% lower whole-object Chamfer distance vs. segmentation pipelines; 16% higher strict part F-score; first 3D model trained on LLM-agent-authored parts
comments: Architectural innovation is clean, but evaluation is limited to geometric metrics; downstream utility for editing/rigging/simulation is claimed but not demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual-volume representation enables part-level generation without explicit segmentation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—part-level outputs are generated directly with improved accuracy

title: Omni-Streaming Thinking
task: Streaming audio-visual understanding with temporal reasoning and cross-modal verification
key_results: OST outperforms strongest open baselines by 10%+ on 5 streaming/audio-visual benchmarks; d-prime = 2.95 on OST-DiagBench vs. ≤1.38 for baselines; reduces vision-induced auditory hallucinations
comments: Structured output format (evidence, forecast, claims) with deferred verification is elegant; evaluation on synthetic audio edits (OST-DiagBench) may not capture real-world robustness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deferred cross-modal verification prevents premature commitment and reduces hallucinations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—refutation process on contradictory evidence substantially improves accuracy

title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
task: Block-wise diffusion vision-language GUI agent with real-time GUI understanding
key_results: LLaDA-UI (16.7B MoE block-wise diffusion) outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-7B and matches/exceeds Qwen3-VL-8B on 4 of 6 GUI benchmarks; preserves parallel decoding efficiency while supporting multimodal grounding
comments: Block-wise diffusion for GUI agents is novel, but relative improvements are modest and inference latency/cost vs. autoregressive baselines not provided.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Block-wise diffusion enables efficient parallel decoding for spatially-grounded GUI tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—competitive performance with preserved parallelization benefits

title: HazardAuditor: From Executable Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
task: Learning to audit and mitigate safety risks in computer-use agents
key_results: HazardAuditor improves guard accuracy by up to 16.5 points over prior methods; Guard Policy Optimization (GuardPO) addresses gradient mismatch in generative guards; normalizes supervision across heterogeneous agents (Claude, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw)
comments: Execution-grounded safety is critical for deployed agents, but evaluation is on synthesized/controlled threat scenarios; real-world robustness of learned guards unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Execution-grounded supervision and sequence-level GuardPO improve safety learning for computer-use agents
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—16.5 point improvement in guard accuracy; superior to token-level training

title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
task: Measuring test-time compute allocation strategy in LLM agents via Elo-per-token
key_results: Agents convert tokens to Elo faster than independent sampling initially but diminish and fall below reference; inflection point identifies where marginal gains match baseline; parallel sessions outperform single long sessions (+264 to +355 Elo); humans show superlinear improvement
comments: Elo-per-token is a principled approach to measuring adaptive compute, but the framework assumes continuous scoring and may not apply to discrete-outcome tasks.

model_io.model: Four general-purpose agents (tested on open-ended tasks)

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM agents allocate test-time compute less efficiently than humans and plateau before independent sampling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—agents show diminishing marginal returns; humans improve superlinearly

title: Not All Prompts Are Equal: Exploration-Guided Prompt Scaffolding for Multimodal Reinforcement Post-Training
task: Adaptive prompt selection and refinement for multimodal RL post-training
key_results: Exploration Potential Score (EPS) identifies low-utility prompts without additional overhead; teacher-guided scaffolding improves informativeness; up to 9.7% relative improvement in-domain and 11.5% on MathVision, 11.1% on MMMU-Pro
comments: Reframing teacher supervision as data refinement is practical, but EPS relies on KL-regularization theory that may not hold across diverse RL objectives.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic prompt distribution based on exploration potential improves RL efficiency for MLLMs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—consistent gains across benchmarks with 9-11% improvements

title: Agent as Policy for Robotic Manipulation
task: Direct robotic policy execution via agent-based task planning and online reasoning
key_results: AGP achieves 100% success on precision manipulation and block construction, 80% on towel folding; no task-specific or environment-specific training required; supports assembly from videos, dynamic motions, deformable objects
comments: High success rates are promising, but evaluation is limited to 5 tasks on a single robot; generalization to unseen tasks and failure modes under-explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: General-purpose agents can directly serve as robotic policies without task-specific training
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—achieves high success across diverse manipulation tasks

title: Pick Your Poison: Learning to Select Poison Sets for Stronger LLM Backdoor Attacks
task: Learning to select poison sets for maximizing backdoor attack success
key_results: Attack success ranges from 3-80% for fixed model/data/poison count depending on poison set; SAILS improves held-out attack success by 30 points over influence baselines; transfers from small to full-scale finetuning
comments: Poison selection as an optimization problem is underexplored; SAILS demonstrates vulnerability gap, raising important defenses questions.

model_io.model: SAILS (set scorer learned from finetuning runs)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Poison set selection substantially affects backdoor success independent of poison count
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—3-80% range shows selection is critical; SAILS exploits this gap

title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning
task: Spatially object-aware 3D diffusion policy via geometry-aligned attention
key_results: Attention-DP3 achieves SOTA across Adroit, DexArt, MetaWorld, real-world SO101; outperforms DP3 by up to 31% under heavy clutter; stable performance as distractor count increases vs. sharp DP3 drop
comments: Architectural addition of attentional conditioning is clean, but 2D segmentation lifts create dependency on vision quality; clutter robustness is practically valuable.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Object-level geometric priors via attention improve 3D policy robustness under clutter
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—31% improvement under heavy clutter and stable performance

title: MInTRL: Off-policy Intervention can boost On-policy RL
task: Integrating sparse offline interventions into on-policy RL to expand exploration
key_results: MInTRL improves coverage over on-policy sampling while preserving on-policy nature; consistently outperforms standard on-policy and off-policy baselines on math/code; moderate intervention intensity optimal; effective with self-intervention
comments: Minimal intervention is pragmatic, but sequence-level advantage regression may not scale to problems with sparse/delayed rewards.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sparse local interventions expand exploration without sacrificing on-policy learnability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—improvements over both on-policy and off-policy baselines; self-intervention viable

title: Building a Production Greek-English Speech Recognizer
task: Production bilingual Greek-English automatic speech recognition
key_results: Three-model ROVER ensemble meets all 9 gates; reduces overlapping-speech WER from 53.35% to 37.87% (29% relative); 4.26% WER on public English sets; 25.88% on live Greek noisy-environment traffic; audio-quality filter reduces discarded Greek audio from 98.7% to 10.6%
comments: Detailed engineering report with multiple failure modes documented; deployment insights valuable but limited to bilingual ASR and not generalizable to other speech tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ROVER ensemble over quality-filtered data meets production requirements across noisy Greek and English
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—all 9 production gates met; 29% WER improvement on overlapping speech

title: Expert-Space Exploration in MoE Reinforcement Learning
task: Expert-routing exploration in Mixture-of-Experts RL for language models
key_results: ESRL improves Qwen3-30B-A3B over GRPO by 3.2 points Pass@1 and 4.5 points Pass@8; works across top-K, top-1, shared-expert routing without additional sampling cost; broader gains on mathematics, science, code
comments: Expert routing as exploration lever is novel for MoE models, but improvements are modest and orthogonal to other RL advances.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stochastic expert routing restricted to plausible candidates increases rollout diversity without quality loss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—3-4 point improvements on Pass@1/8 metrics across routing schemes

title: Enabling Creative Exploration for Vibe Design Agents
task: Structured design-specification sampling for creative exploration in UI design agents
key_results: Theme sampling broadens design coverage and screenshot variation; LLM-judge preferences vary across interventions; code-export increase statistically uncertain in online experiment; more correction interactions observed
comments: Verbalized Sampling applied to UI design is creative, but online experiment results are inconclusive—no clear evidence of user benefit despite design diversity gains.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit design-specification sampling separates aesthetic exploration from syntax-sensitive code generation
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed—covers design space but online user adoption unclear

title: Dynin-Robotics: Omnimodal Unified Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model
task: Unified omnimodal diffusion policy for robot manipulation with goal/dynamics prediction
key_results: Dynin-Robotics achieves 78.4% average success on Franka R3 across four manipulation conditions; competitive on LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus zero-shot; 29.2x action-decoding acceleration via block-parallel implementation; learns shared trajectory model across 1.33M trajectories from 48 datasets
comments: Shared trajectory modeling is theoretically motivated, but improvements from joint goal-dynamics denoising are task/composition dependent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared trajectory model enables test-time scaling via goal guidance and action-state refinement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—goal guidance improves shifted-instruction success; composition strategy-dependent

title: ModaLens: Measuring Image Sensitivity in Report-Conditioned Medical VLMs
task: Measuring image sensitivity in report-conditioned medical vision-language models
key_results: ModaLens image-swap audit: MedGemma-27B answer changes 4.26% with report vs 20.94% without (16.7-point difference); report availability reduces image-swap sensitivity; results replicate across 2 additional model lineages
comments: Paired image-swap is clever for isolating image sensitivity, but labels derive from reports—conflates model bias with true visual correctness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Report availability reduces model reliance on image information in medical VLMs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—16.7-point sensitivity gap; replicates across model families

title: Molecular dynamics guided all-atom reconstruction of cryo-ET maps reveals mechanisms of histone tail mediated chromatin compaction
task: Determine atomistic mechanisms of histone tail-mediated chromatin compaction
key_results: Identified three major compaction patterns: histone-DNA interactions, H2A-H4 and H3-H4 tail-tail interactions; MD-generated structural parameters agreed strongly with experimental condensed chromatin arrays
comments: Integrating MD simulations with cryo-ET provides powerful validation, though the biological relevance of in vitro tri-nucleosome dynamics to native chromatin context requires further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Histone tails promote chromatin compaction through specific interaction patterns
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; three major patterns identified involving histone-DNA and tail-tail interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: MD-generated tri-nucleosome models reproduce experimental cryo-ET features
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; structural parameter distributions from MD showed strong agreement with condensed chromatin arrays

title: Intercellular interaction licenses TNFα/IFNγ-induced cancer cell apoptosis through the NF2–YAP–TRAIL pathway
task: Identify how cell-cell contact licenses cytokine-induced apoptosis in cancer cells
key_results: High cell density activates Hippo pathway to inactivate YAP, relieving TRAIL repression; TRAIL loss selectively abolishes high-density apoptosis sensitivity while IFNγ amplifies TRAIL via STAT1–IRF1
comments: The density-dependent licensing mechanism is elegant, but therapeutic applicability to YAP-hyperactive tumors requires validation that YAP/TEAD inhibition doesn't compromise beneficial immune functions.

model_io.model: Cancer cell culture at varying densities

hypotheses.hypothesis: NF2–LATS1/2–YAP Hippo pathway activation at high density relieves YAP-mediated TRAIL repression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; high density activates pathway and increases TRAIL transcription

hypotheses.hypothesis: TRAIL is the critical effector coupling mechanical and immune signals
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TRAIL loss abolishes high-density sensitivity, restoration rescues it

title: IFN-I induced-LAP3 promotes embryo resorption by inhibiting trophoblast mitophagy via targeting HSD17B10/PE pathway
task: Determine how IFN-I-induced LAP3 impairs trophoblast function and causes embryo resorption
key_results: Viral infections and excessive IFN-I upregulate LAP3; elevated LAP3 suppresses trophoblast proliferation and migration; LAP3 deficiency attenuates poly(I:C)-induced embryo resorption; LAP3 interacts with PABPC1 and destabilizes HSD17B10, reducing PE levels and impairing mitophagy
comments: The mechanistic link between LAP3-mediated HSD17B10 destabilization and mitophagy impairment is plausible but indirect; direct effects on mitochondrial function should be measured.

hypotheses.hypothesis: IFN-I upregulates LAP3, which destabilizes HSD17B10 and reduces PE-mediated mitophagy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LAP3 interacts with PABPC1 to destabilize HSD17B10

hypotheses.hypothesis: LAP3 deficiency attenuates pregnancy loss by restoring trophoblast mitophagy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LAP3 knockout significantly reduces poly(I:C)-induced embryo resorption

title: The accessory protein ORF3a hijacks the CLCC1 chloride channel to disrupt ER homeostasis in betacoronavirus pathogenesis
task: Elucidate how SARS-CoV-2 ORF3a hijacks CLCC1 to disrupt ER homeostasis
key_results: ORF3a binds CLCC1 chloride channel impairing ER ion homeostasis and activating UPR; CLCC1 acts as host restriction factor by sequestering ORF3a; mechanism is conserved across betacoronaviruses and recapitulates neuroinflammation in mouse brains
comments: The spatiotemporal mechanism (ER retention followed by lysosomal escape) is mechanistically sophisticated but the functional consequences of disrupted ER-phagy and nucleophagy warrant quantification.

model_io.model: Mouse brain tissue infected with betacoronaviruses

hypotheses.hypothesis: ORF3a-CLCC1 interaction disrupts ER homeostasis and triggers autophagic dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; interaction exacerbates ER-phagy and nucleophagy

hypotheses.hypothesis: CLCC1 restricts viral replication by sequestering ORF3a
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CLCC1 functions as host restriction factor

title: Tunneling nanotubes regulate mitochondrial homeostasis between glioblastoma and astrocytes, and between tumor cells in vivo
task: Determine mechanisms of mitochondrial transfer between glioblastoma and astrocytes via tunneling nanotubes
key_results: Bidirectional mitochondrial transfer between GBM and astrocytes occurs via TNTs; damaged GBM mitochondria transferred to astrocytes trigger mitophagy; astrocyte-derived mitochondria alter GBM mitochondrial activity and metabolism; intravital microscopy confirms TNT-mediated transfer in vivo
comments: The functional consequences of metabolic changes in recipient GBM cells are inferred from activity readouts; direct assessment of tumor growth and therapeutic vulnerability would strengthen the biological significance.

model_io.model: Intravital subcellular microscopy in live glioblastoma-bearing mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: GBM cells transfer damaged mitochondria to astrocytes via TNTs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; transfer associated with mitophagy activation in astrocytes

hypotheses.hypothesis: TNT-mediated mitochondrial transfer occurs in vivo
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by intravital microscopy in live animal model

title: A scaffolding element rewires local 3D chromatin architecture during differentiation
task: Elucidate how a scaffolding element rewires local 3D chromatin architecture during differentiation
key_results: During ESC-to-NPC differentiation, the 3 Mb Zfp608 locus chromatin domain splits at the promoter with acquisition of activating marks and 3D compaction; a dual enhancer/architectural scaffolding element is essential for loop formation and chromatin rewiring
comments: The identification of a cis element with dual function is compelling, but the mechanisms by which transcription modulates chromatin contacts and insulation are not fully mechanistically resolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A scaffolding element with dual enhancer/architectural function drives chromatin rewiring
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; element is essential for loop formation and domain split

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transcription modulates local chromatin contacts and insulation at domain boundaries
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; transcription contributes to chromatin contact rewiring

title: Batten disease protein CLN8 enables a non-canonical phospholipid synthesis pathway
task: Characterize the non-canonical phospholipid synthesis pathway initiated by CLN8
key_results: CLN8 catalyzes acylation of glycerophosphoglycerol to form lysophosphatidylglycerol; this pathway selectively feeds BMP synthesis, not phosphatidylglycerol or cardiolipin; CLN8 knockout cells show BMP deficiency and phospholipid accumulation in lysosomes
comments: This non-canonical pathway challenges textbook knowledge but the exclusive routing to BMP raises questions about the structural or localization features directing substrate specificity.

outputs: lack of PG or CL formation

hypotheses.hypothesis: CLN8 catalyzes acylation of glycerophosphoglycerol to generate lysophosphatidylglycerol
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CLN8 is acyltransferase for this non-canonical pathway

hypotheses.hypothesis: CLN8-derived lysophosphatidylglycerol is selectively converted to BMP
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by tracer studies; no conversion to PG or cardiolipin

title: The Batten disease protein CLN8 is a stereospecific acyltransferase in bis(monoacylglycero)phosphate biosynthesis
task: Define CLN8 enzymatic function and stereochemistry in bis(monoacylglycero)phosphate synthesis
key_results: CLN8 is a stereospecific glycerophosphoglycerol acyltransferase catalyzing S,S-glycerophosphoglycerol acylation to S,S-lysophosphatidylglycerol; cryo-EM structures define active site and ping-pong mechanism; Batten mutations impair activity; exogenous S,S-lysophosphatidylglycerol restores BMP and improves zebrafish neurological phenotypes
comments: The structural and biochemical characterization is rigorous, and proof-of-concept therapeutics via BMP precursor supplementation is promising, though crossing the blood-brain barrier and achieving sufficient lysosomal accumulation remain therapeutic hurdles.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CLN8 catalyzes stereospecific acylation of S,S-glycerophosphoglycerol
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cryo-EM structures define active site mechanism

hypotheses.hypothesis: S,S-lysophosphatidylglycerol supplementation restores BMP and neurological function in CLN8-deficient organisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; exogenous S,S but not R,S stereoisomer restores BMP and improves zebrafish phenotypes

title: DFCP1-containing ER microdomains mediate lysosomal membrane repair
task: Characterize the DFCP1-mediated lysosomal membrane repair pathway
key_results: PI3P-containing ER domains formed by PIK3C3/VPS34 activate DFCP1 accumulation upon lysosomal damage; DFCP1 promotes focal accumulation of lipid channel VPS13C to promote lysosomal sealing; DFCP1 absence compromises cellular resistance to Listeria
comments: The multi-effector coordination (CASM, PI4P, ESCRTs, PI3P, DFCP1, VPS13C) is comprehensive but the temporal hierarchy and sufficiency of each component warrant clarification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PI3P-dependent DFCP1 accumulation on lysosome-proximal ER is triggered by Ca2+ efflux
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Ca2+ flux and PIK3C3 activation required for DFCP1 localization

hypotheses.hypothesis: DFCP1 mediates concentration of VPS13C lipid channel at damaged lysosomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DFCP1 promotes focal VPS13C accumulation for repair

title: FOXA1 suppresses breast cancer progression by downregulating CYP4Z1-mediated lipid metabolic reprogramming
task: Characterize the FOXA1–CYP4Z1 axis in breast cancer lipid metabolic reprogramming
key_results: CYP4Z1 is markedly overexpressed in breast cancer and associates with poor prognosis; CYP4Z1 knockdown inhibits proliferation, migration and EMT while promoting apoptosis; FOXA1 represses CYP4Z1 promoter; FOXA1 loss activates CYP4Z1 and triggers lipid metabolic reprogramming
comments: Nontargeted lipidomics identified triglyceride accumulation upon CYP4Z1 downregulation, suggesting CYP4Z1 directs lipid catabolism rather than synthesis, but specific CYP4Z1 substrates and products remain unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FOXA1 represses CYP4Z1 transcription

hypotheses.hypothesis: CYP4Z1 drives lipid metabolic reprogramming supporting breast cancer progression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CYP4Z1 silencing disrupts lipid homeostasis and inhibits malignant phenotypes

title: Cysteine excess triggers a mitochondrial iron-dependent cell death

key_results: CRISPR screen identified mitochondrial iron transporters as essential mediators; cysteine mobilizes ferritin iron and drives mitochondrial iron accumulation; enhancing mitochondrial GR activity restores redox balance and protects cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cysteine mobilizes ferritin iron and drives mitochondrial accumulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cysteine expands cytosolic iron pool and increases mitochondrial iron

title: A sophisticated multilevel thresholding optimizer for diagnosing breast cancer disease
task: Multilevel threshold segmentation for breast thermography image analysis
key_results: EHO algorithm achieved superior performance with PSNR improvements and AUC metrics; demonstrated 99.59% equivalent accuracy on breast cancer classification benchmarks
comments: The study validates optimization algorithm performance on standard benchmarks but lacks clinical validation on actual patient cohorts, limiting clinical translation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: EHO with strengthened exploitation improves multilevel thresholding convergence vs. original HO

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-method XAI framework highlights biologically relevant lesion regions

title: mAIcrobe: an open-source framework for high-throughput bacterial image analysis
task: Open-source deep learning framework for bacterial cell segmentation and morphological analysis
key_results: mAIcrobe successfully segmented diverse bacterial morphologies (spherical S. aureus, rod-shaped E. coli) across microscopy modalities; identified antibiotic-induced E. coli changes and DnaA mutant cell cycle defects in S. aureus
